identity.title: Freeze golden demo topic and production polish

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Choose the most defensible live topic from three pre-tested examples, polish only the golden path, deploy early, and produce screenshot-safe output.
human_pressure.why_now: The evaluated artifact is the working demo, not the backlog.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: No new feature starts in this pack.
Do not tune rules to manufacture a preferred finding for the demo.

machine_core.goal: Run live smoke analysis for the candidate topics, select one golden demo, fix only presentation-blocking defects, and validate deployment in an incognito browser.
red_lines: No new feature starts in this pack.
Do not tune rules to manufacture a preferred finding for the demo.
invariants: Demo result remains produced by the same public methodology.

steps.title: Evaluate three live topics
details: AI Agent Governance, Climate Adaptation, Quantum Computing.
Choose the clearest defensible result; do not force a desired conclusion.

steps.title: Deploy
details: Use the already chosen hosting target.
Verify environment and server-side provider access.

steps.title: Polish only the golden path
details: Fix clipping, wording, evidence links and loading/error presentation.

acceptance: One live golden topic works repeatedly.
Screenshots can be captured without unfinished UI.

must_check: One live golden topic works repeatedly.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
